name: mercurians_settler
description: a Mercurian Settler (Fall from Heaven), an angelic young pilgrim: spiky blond hair, a gold halo floating above the head, small white feathered wings behind the shoulders, a blue-and-white tunic with gold trim and a white scarf collar, a brown belt with a gold buckle and a brown pouch, white leggings, silver greaves and boots, a big cream backpack on his back (screen-left) topped by a rolled blue bedroll with gold straps and a tin pot hanging from the pack on the screen-left, and a tall wooden walking staff topped by a gold star in his LEFT hand (screen-right)
hands: the star-topped walking staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side holds the backpack strap at his chest, an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the walking staff is lifted up over the head with its gold-star top pointing up and back, the big backpack still on his back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the walking staff cocked behind the head with its gold-star top hanging down behind the shoulders, the right hand an empty fist tucked in at the chest
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the walking staff is level, its gold-star top pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: staff arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the star-topped walking staff whacking down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the walking staff carries on down until its gold-star top nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the blond hair and the small wings trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the walking staff lifts back toward its upright ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the staff arm thrown up and out), the heavy backpack lurching
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the star-topped walking staff dipping, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the staff arm flung up, the empty right hand drooping, the backpack pulling him back
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the walking staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the gold-star top of the walking staff resting on the ground, the empty right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left onto the backpack, the walking staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the big backpack and the blue bedroll under his shoulders; the star-topped walking staff lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the small wings settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the star-topped walking staff on the ground beside him, the backpack under his shoulders
